title: The Beach House
meta_description: Luxury 30A beach house in gated Bluewater Landing. This 30A vacation rental sleeps 14, includes golf cart, bikes, fire pit—steps from the beach!
description_expanded: AboutThe Beach House | Coastal Luxury Vacation Rental on 30A | Gated Community | Golf Cart, Bikes, Fire Pit and More Bluewater Landing – 30A, Florida | 4 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 14 | South of 30A | New Build | Close to Beach Access Discover The Beach House, a brand-new luxury vacation rental nestled in the exclusive gated Bluewater Landing community, just south of Scenic Highway 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. Designed with style and comfort in mind, this professionally decorated coastal home offers the perfect blend of modern luxury and laid-back beach vibes. Enjoy quick access to the sugar-white sand beaches of the Emerald Coast, all while being close to the best dining, boutique shopping, and entertainment 30A has to offer. Property Highlights ● South of 30A – Prime location close to beach access ● 6-Seater Golf Cart – Cruise to the beach or local hotspots ● Gated Bluewater Landing Community – Quiet, private, and secure ● 4 Bedrooms | 3.5 Bathrooms | Sleeps 14 – Ideal for families or groups ● Fishing Poles ● Fitness Weights – For active travelers ● 4 Bicycles Included – Explore scenic 30A in style ● Outdoor Fire Pit with Lounge Seating – Perfect for evening gatherings ● Outdoor Shower and Grill – For post-beach refresh and backyard BBQs ● Fully Stocked Kitchen – With stainless steel appliances and island seating ● Back Deck with Outdoor Furniture – Relax, dine, or sip your morning coffee ● Beach Gear Provided – 4 backpack chairs and umbrella ● Free WiFi, Smart TVs, and Games – Entertainment for all ages ● Two Onsite Parking Spaces and Overflow Parking Nearby Coastal Comfort Meets Designer Style Step inside this open-concept 30A vacation home and be welcomed by calming tones, abundant natural light, and gorgeous coastal-inspired décor. The main living area on the second floor is designed for connection—featuring a spacious living room with plush seating, a stylish dining space, and a chef’s kitchen with high-end finishes. Whether you’re whipping up a beach-day brunch or gathering for game night, this space is the true heart of the home. Enjoy evenings outdoors on the back deck, complete with comfortable seating and serene views. Roast marshmallows around the solo stove fire pit, rinse off the sand in the outdoor shower, or fire up the grill for dinner al fresco. Sleep and Recharge in Style First Floor – ● Bunk Retreat and Game Zone: A kid and teen favorite, this level includes two double-over-queen bunk beds, a private ensuite bath with walk-in shower, a TV, and a game area for late-night fun. Third Floor – ● Primary Suite: Relax in the king-size primary bedroom featuring a sitting area, smart TV, and a spa-inspired ensuite with a walk-in shower. ● Two Queen Bedrooms: Perfect for couples or additional guests, these rooms share a full bathroom with a shower/tub combo and offer both comfort and privacy. Thoughtful Touches and Starter Amenities We’ve stocked The Beach House with a starter pack to start your vacation stress-free: Starbucks coffee pack, creamer, sugar & bottled water, paper towels, dish soap, kitchen sponge, dishwasher tabs, laundry pods, pillow spray, shampoo, conditioner, aloe, lotion, hand soap, and one roll of toilet paper per bathroom. Unbeatable Location – South of 30A Located in the heart of 30A, The Beach House offers a premium location just a short golf cart ride to the nearest beach access. You're also just minutes away from 30A’s top attractions, including: ● Gulf Place Town Center ● Local boutiques and art galleries ● Award-winning restaurants and beach bars ● Scenic bike trails and state parks Whether you're looking to unwind by the sea, explore charming coastal towns, or relax in luxury with your favorite people, The Beach House is your go-to 30A vacation rental for an unforgettable stay. Book your dream beach getaway at The Beach House today – exclusively with FunVacay. Coastal luxury, prime location, and thoughtful amenities await.
